description.en: Adds tree, rag, misc, and handoff tools plus local session metering to OpenCode and DeepSeek Harness (DSH). rag supports an optional cheap-model filter that selects 3-5 candidates before injection; the bundle installer adds the plugin shim, three skills, and RAG tooling.
description.zh: 为 OpenCode 与 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）提供 tree、rag、misc、handoff 工具与本机会话计量。rag 支持可选的便宜模型筛选（先筛 3-5 条候选再注入）；bundle 一键安装包会安装插件 shim、三个 skills 与 RAG 工具。
